changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6a item 2c: moved resolveAgent and defaultAgentRuntime from the now-deleted service/agent/agent-config.ts into config/config.ts beside the existing dispatcherAgent() accessor, updating their three importers (service/agent/{activity,runtime-generation,index}.ts). agentRuntimeCapability, previously a free function in agent-config.ts used only by TeammateCollection.getCapabilities(), is now a private TeammateCollection method that reads its AgentRuntimeProviderCatalog off `this.opts` instead of taking it as a parameter. Also deleted the InboundDeliveryResult type and asInboundDeliveryResult converter from service/agent/admission.ts: they were a redundant narrower projection of TurnAdmission with no caller-visible difference (SchedulerServiceOptions.submitScheduled's only reader, scheduler/service.ts's submitDue, checks status !== 'submitted' && status !== 'ambiguous', which behaves identically against the wider TurnAdmission). scheduler/types.ts's submitScheduled now returns Promise<TurnAdmission> directly, and both callers (team-service/index.ts's and dispatcher-service/index.ts's submitScheduled wiring, the latter sharing the same SchedulerServiceOptions shape) drop the asInboundDeliveryResult(...) wrapper since submitToLeader/AgentService.submitInput already return Promise<TurnAdmission>. Internal type/import consolidation only: every scheduler cron fire's observable admission outcome is unchanged.
